subject: sentences
title: Writing dates
about: How a date is written: a capital letter on the month or day name, and a comma between the day number and the year (May 5, 2027). Each date card has one choice missing the capital and one missing the comma, so it builds on the Commas in dates level. Both rules are first grade in North Carolina; commas in a list come later.
tip: Have him check two things: does the month start with a capital, and does the comma sit between the day number and the year?
